results.author: Wendy Marshall
results.text:
Unlocking Creativity: A Review of the Mead Composition Notebook for Every Student - Too Much To Write

 

## 29 Jun Unlocking Creativity: A Review of the Mead Composition Notebook for Every Student

 Posted at 16:13h in Reviews by Wendy Marshall 

### A Trusted Companion: Review of the Mead Composition Wide Ruled Notebook

There’s something undeniably nostalgic about the classic black marble cover of a Mead Composition notebook. It takes me back to my school days when I’d scribble down thoughts, ideas, and the endless lists that kept my scattered brain afloat. So when I stumbled upon the Mead Composition, Wide Ruled Comp Book, I couldn’t resist giving it a whirl. This notebook, measuring 9-3/4" x 7-1/2" and containing 100 sheets, feels like a warm hug for those of us who love the tactile sensation of pen on paper.

The Mead Composition notebook is striking in its simplicity. Its durable covers are sewn and tape-bound for extra strength, promising to stand up to whatever creative chaos I can throw at it. The inside cover features a class schedule grid—perfect for students of all ages, whether you’re mapping out your semester or just keeping track of your weekly tasks. The additional multiplication and conversion tables, plus grammar rules on the back, are thoughtful touches tailored for today’s busy learners. 

Now, let’s talk paper. Each sheet is wide-ruled and sturdy, ensuring that whether I’m using a gel pen or a classic ballpoint, I can pour my ideas down without the worry of bleeding through to the next page. This was a major plus for me, and my newfound love for doodling meant that the quality of the paper really mattered. The lines guide me, but the pages breathe space, allowing my creativity to flourish without feeling cramped.

In my quest to find the ideal notebook, I wasn’t just looking for function; I craved inspiration. This notebook has turned into a sanctuary for my thoughts—be it reminders about upcoming blog posts, notes from online courses, or even musings about life. It’s become a solid companion for my reflections, offering a sense of organization that I admit I often lack. One reviewer, JojoB, captured it beautifully when they mentioned that it helps keep their ideas together, sharing the joy of seeing all their poetic thoughts in one place.

As I leaf through the pages, I can’t help but be reminded of the reviews that praised the Mead Composition book for being more than just a school supply. As Trent, another satisfied customer, expressed, it’s a “handy dandy notebook” that serves not only students but professionals too. Whether you’re in real estate or just someone looking to jot down important thoughts, this notebook fits seamlessly into daily life. 

In conclusion, I wholeheartedly recommend the Mead Composition Wide Ruled Notebook to anyone who appreciates the charm of writing on paper. Whether you’re a student, a professional, or someone simply looking to declutter their thoughts, this notebook invites you to explore the joys of writing. Its sturdy design makes it perfect for everyday use, and there’s a comforting familiarity in its pages that invites creativity. 

For anyone looking to embrace their thoughts authentically, I say grab a Mead Composition notebook, and perhaps, like me, you might rediscover the magic of putting pen to paper.

Mead Wide‑Ruled Composition Notebook 7.5x9.75 - Dukuc

# Mead Wide‑Ruled Composition Notebook — 7.5 x 9.75, 100 Sheets

 4.8 12 reviews · 1 min read · Updated 4 October 2026 

4.8/ 5

Brand

Mead

## Product description

This composition notebook includes 100 double-sided, wide-ruled sheets — plenty of space for notes, classwork, journaling, and casual sketches. The pages measure 7.5 inches by 9.75 inches, offering a mid-size format that fits backpacks without taking up extra room.

The soft black marble cover protects the contents while remaining flexible and lightweight. Sewn binding secures the pages and helps the book lie flat when open, making it easier to write across both halves of the spread.

Inside the front and back covers you’ll find useful reference aids such as a class schedule, multiplication tables, conversion charts, and grammar tips. This keeps quick-reference material available during study sessions and note-taking.

## Pros

- 100 double-sided wide-ruled pages
- Sewn binding lies flat and holds pages secure
- Inside-cover reference tables for school use

## Cons

- Soft cover offers less protection than a hardback
- Paper can show bleed with heavier inks
- Not designed for long-term archival storage

Verdict A reliable, everyday composition book that covers the basics: 100 double-sided wide-ruled pages, a sewn spine that stays intact and opens flat, and handy reference tables on the inside covers. Good for students, journaling, note-taking, and casual sketching. Not a premium archival option, but solid for daily use.

## Reviews

1. A AYISHA SALIFU 5/5 

### Grateful

Thank you — good quality and does the job well.
2. M msox812 5/5 

### Solid choice

Good school supply — bright cover, decent build, and good value. Would buy again.
3. T Traci Musgrove 5/5 

### Tough and reliable

I do a lot of writing and these hold together even when I’m hard on them. I’ll buy again.
4. J Josh McGee 5/5 

### Really like it

Very durable and nicely made. Cover color is classic, pages don’t bleed through, and the layout is easy to write on. Useful reference content inside the covers.
5. W Whitney Jo Deseth 5/5 

### Dependable school staple

Sturdy and straightforward — wide-ruled paper, a durable cover, and reliable construction. Exactly what you expect from a plain composition book. Good value and ideal for back-to-school needs.
6. M maria de guzman 5/5 

### Perfect for my 5th grader

Bought a 3-pack for my child and they’ve been great for school. Wide-ruled lines give younger hands room to form letters, the black marble cover holds up in backpacks, and the sewn spine keeps pages intact all year. 100 sheets is a good amount for classes.
7. K kristofer 4/5 

### Loses quality over time

Initially the paper is smooth and fairly bleed-resistant, but after months it can become rougher and less sturdy. If you’ll use it up quickly it’s great; for long-term storage it declines in quality.
8. J JP De Oliveira Estêvão 5/5 

### Surprisingly good paper

Paper feels nicer than typical school notebooks and resists bleed-through with most pens. Size fits a backpack easily. Durable enough to survive daily use and casual tossing around.
9. S Sergio I. 5/5 

### Solid, functional notebooks

These are practical and affordable notebooks for students and professionals. Compact size fits bags easily, covers are sturdy enough for everyday use, and the stapled spine keeps pages secure though they don’t open fully flat.
10. H Hagrid 3/5 

### Paper too thin for fine liners

Paper is on the thin side and fine-liners show through, making the reverse side less usable. I only gave a middling rating because of quick delivery; value is limited if you need bleedproof sheets.
11. L Lucia 5/5 

### Well-made, with a caveat

Cardboard covers keep the notebooks light and sewn binding avoids bulky spirals. Wide-ruled pages and decent paper weight make writing comfortable. Only downside is price—best picked up during promotions.
12. F Fatumatu Abbas 5/5 

### Good

Does what it’s meant to do — a good, plain composition notebook.

## Comments

No comments yet.

results.title: Mead Composition Notebook, Wide Ruled Paper, 9-3/4" x 7-1/2", 100 Sheets per Comp Book, Black/White (09920)
results.text:
# Mead Composition Notebook, Wide Ruled Paper, 9-3/4" x 7-1/2", 100 Sheets per Comp Book, Black/White (09920)
Brand: Mead
Category: Notebooks & Writing Pads > Composition Notebooks

## Pricing & Reviews
Price: 3.6 USD.
Rated 4.5 from 489 reviews.

## Description
This Mead Square Deal Journal Composition Book provides a unique way to take notes. The top half of page is open for graphs and drawings, while the bottom half is wide ruled for notetaking. Sheets measure 9-3/4" x 7-1/2". Contains 100 double-sided sheets. Wide ruling is ideal for the younger student who needs more space between lines. Black marble cover includes a class schedule, multiplication tables, conversion tables and grammar rule. Sewn binding is smooth and keeps pages securely in place. Lays flat on any surface.

ASIN: B000E21OR2
